replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, definitely. When I see complex formulas, my heart races. My neuroticism is high, so I feel pressure. replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried using AI tools, but I wasn't fully satisfied. Sometimes the explanations were too technical, and I felt overwhelmed.
